correctness.rationale: For connected wheel Laplacian, two-step firing totals must be a constant 1 in every primitive orbit; the two complementary firing cuts give exact independent local chip intervals. The hub-firing phase is unique per temporal orbit. Multiplying the 4-state cyclic pair weights yields H_m(z)=2 z^m( tr T(z,1)^m - tr T(z,z)^m)/(1-z). Isolated phase-A runs r give every mass in [3m-r,4m+r-1], maximal r=floor(m/2), and complementary interval palindromicity yields H_m(z)=z^(7m-1)H_m(1/z). Direct independent enumeration m=3..5 reproduced 120,552,2250 primitive states and sharp supports. This is a proof for all m>=3, not an extrapolation from checks.
